operational_definition: Number of negative responses among the two to four observed items on women's-policy institutional capacity; unavailable responses are not converted into deficits.
role_in_model: Sole indicator of the institutional-deficit dimension
documented_limitation: Self-reported municipal information; unequal observed-item coverage requires sensitivity reporting.

operational_definition: Count of absent service types among hospitals, psychosocial care centers (CAPS), and emergency units.
role_in_model: One of two indicators averaged within the health component
documented_limitation: Presence does not measure quality, capacity, opening hours, affordability, or effective access.

operational_definition: Count of absent professional categories among psychologists and social workers registered in CNES.
role_in_model: One of two indicators averaged within the health component
documented_limitation: Registered professionals do not establish availability, continuity, workload adequacy, or service quality.

operational_definition: Binary absence of every mapped specialized social-assistance service among CREAS, Centro POP, Centro-Dia, and institutional shelter units.
reference_period: Repository snapshot; publication period to be fixed before submission
role_in_model: Sole indicator of the social-protection component
documented_limitation: Administrative presence does not measure service capacity, quality, frequency, or effective access.

operational_definition: Binary absence of mapped local TJPA access through a court unit, criminal unit, special court, CEJUSC, or specialized women's unit.
reference_period: Repository snapshot; publication period to be fixed before submission
role_in_model: Sole indicator of the justice component
documented_limitation: Mapped local presence does not measure caseload, quality, timeliness, or practical accessibility.

operational_definition: Number of distinct validated protection-network service categories mapped in the municipality.
model_direction: Lower means greater priority (cost criterion reversed)
reference_period: Repository snapshot; publication period to be fixed before submission
role_in_model: One of two indicators averaged within the specialized-protection component
documented_limitation: Coverage depends on source records and validation; category diversity does not measure capacity or quality.

operational_definition: Number of validated specialized non-health protection services mapped in the municipality.
model_direction: Lower means greater priority (cost criterion reversed)
reference_period: Repository snapshot; publication period to be fixed before submission
role_in_model: One of two indicators averaged within the specialized-protection component
documented_limitation: Mapped services may be incomplete; counts do not measure capacity, quality, frequency, or affordability.

operational_definition: One minus each municipal multimodal access score. Twelve predeclared access scenarios cross four modal structures (equal, road, waterway, or air emphasis) with three role structures (equal, availability, or proximity emphasis).
source: MapBiomas roads; ANTAQ waterway infrastructure; DECEA/ICA aeronautical infrastructure
reference_period: Road layer registered as 2023; other source snapshots to be fixed before submission
role_in_model: One scenario-specific indicator of the transport-barrier dimension
documented_limitation: Infrastructure presence and mapped proximity do not represent travel time, service frequency, affordability, connectivity, or seasonality.
